text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is about to start.
Meanwhile,
Голд Шип is contemplating
the race in terms of
life itself.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Conquer a mountain, and you'll be led
back to
the ocean! No one can stop
Голд Шип once she
starts rowing. The
same is true for races.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп must now race against her
longtime
rivals. The curtains rise on the
ultimate race of the
Twinkle Series!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
